task.md:
# Development task

## preload
From the worktree root, read _nestos/kanban/manifest.json and _nestos/kanban/protocol.json before starting. Follow the frozen manifest commit policy and repository bindings. Your role guidance and task inputs remain separate. Verify the worktree and repository branches.

## run
If this is a subtask, execute only its own responsibility and acceptance; do not repeat the parent or sibling work. First inspect existing implementation and verify satisfied requirements without rewriting them. Implement only the assigned work, run meaningful tests, and publish immutable progress, clarification, error and result messages using protocol.json. Preserve logs without secrets. For changes mode leave modifications uncommitted. For worktree mode commit only to the registered task branches, children before parent gitlinks. Never merge, push, delete worktrees or change shared service state as part of delivery.

## postload.succeeded
Report changed files, actual checks, commit IDs or uncommitted changes, and limitations. Publish a result request; the host performs independent verification.

## postload.failed
Inspect the failure evidence provided by the host. Summarize the cause and recovery options into artifacts without retrying development or committing.

## postload.cancelled
Summarize the retained workspace and recovery information into artifacts. Do not resume or continue the cancelled task.

## cleanup
Retain branches, worktrees and session history. The host releases owned observation resources after execution settlement.


## Context requests and commit attribution
For additional task or decision context read exchange.json and publish a work-message/2 request, then end the current turn without a result or terminal hooks. The host publishes a response and continues this same Session. Never poll or write outbox files. For worktree commit mode append every trailer from commit-trailers.txt unchanged to each new commit, including independent repositories. In changes mode do not commit. If returned context is missing or ambiguous, report clarification instead of guessing or approving a merge.
